Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — prepping the partner ops QBR (mid-July). Need three things from everyone by EOD Wed: SI integration readouts (1-2 bullets each), updated scorecards (one-liners OK), and proposed MDF asks + allocation rationale. cc @Alex Rivera for marketplace/HW credits numbers. :calendar:

Alex Rivera: Uploaded marketplace snapshot here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcd1234 — will drop the forecast + HW credits tab by EOD. Topline: APAC marketplace demand +18% q/q; provisional HW credit request = $120k.

Jamal Ortiz: SI readout (short):
- Acme Systems: staging pass, waiting on security certs (blocker)
- DataForge: infra dependency causing delay, new ETA Aug 3
- NovaSI: on track for integration test next week
I'll paste per-SI bullets in the drive in a minute. @Olivia Park can you confirm MDF gating for stalled SI?

Olivia Park: For MDF prioritization propose buckets:
1) Launch support (50%)
2) Co-marketing (30%)
3) Deal acceleration (20%)
Also — question: can marketplace HW credits be reallocated into co-marketing for strategic partners? Need a thumbs by Wed.

PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: QBR deck template & intake form -> https://redwood.ai/qbr-template. Please submit slides + scorecards by 2024-07-10 17:00 UTC. Automated reminder will go out 48h before deadline. :bell:

Maya Chen: Example scorecard CSV snippet to copy/paste if helpful:
```
partner,quarter,leads,closed_rev,engagement_score,tier_reco
Acme Systems,2024Q2,34,120000,78,Bronze->Silver
DataForge,2024Q2,12,42000,60,Bronze
NovaSI,2024Q2,50,240000,88,Gold
```
Paste a one-line summary if you can't do full CSV.

Alex Rivera: Quick ask — can we carve out $30k for APAC beta vouchers? If yes I'll mark it in the spreadsheet under "APAC pilot".

Jamal Ortiz: +1 for the APAC carve. Also we should run a short PM sync with SI leads — propose Thu 09:00 PT (30m).

Olivia Park: Scheduled Thu 09:00 PT and sending invites now. Final deliverables checklist:
- one-slide partner health per partner
- scorecard CSV (or one-line summary)
- MDF allocation table (csv or sheet)
- SI readout bullets (blockers + ETA)

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks all. If anyone needs an extension, ping me here with the reason and new ETA. :thumbsup:
